discrim.title: Discriminant Analysis
discrim.exclVar: At least one missing discriminating variable
discrim.exclBoth: Both missing or out-of-range group codes and at least one missing discriminating variable
discrim.exclVarAny: At least one missing discriminating variable
discrim.univf: Tests of Equality of Group Means
discrim.covDf: The covariance matrix has {{df}} degrees of freedom.
discrim.tcovDf: The total covariance matrix has {{df}} degrees of freedom.
discrim.allPassing: All variables passing the tolerance criteria are entered simultaneously.
discrim.noVarsEntered: No variable passed the tolerance or entry criteria; the analysis cannot be performed.
discrim.logDetNote: The ranks and natural logarithms of determinants printed are those of the group covariance matrices.
discrim.boxNote: Tests null hypothesis of equal population covariance matrices.
discrim.boxSingular: Groups with singular covariance matrices are left out of the test.
discrim.boxImpossible: Box's M cannot be computed: fewer than two groups have non-singular covariance matrices.
discrim.priorsCount: PRIORS lists {{n}} values but there are {{g}} non-empty groups.
discrim.priorsScaled: The prior probabilities do not sum to 1; they have been rescaled.
discrim.badPriors: PRIORS values must be non-negative numbers with a positive sum.
discrim.singular: The pooled within-groups covariance matrix of the variables in the analysis is singular.
discrim.firstUsed: First {{n}} canonical discriminant functions were used in the analysis.
discrim.structureNote: Pooled within-groups correlations between discriminating variables and standardized canonical discriminant functions. Variables ordered by absolute size of correlation within function.
discrim.notUsed: This variable not used in the analysis.
discrim.largestCorr: Largest absolute correlation between each variable and any discriminant function
discrim.centroidsNote: Unstandardized canonical discriminant functions evaluated at group means
discrim.pctCorrect: {{pct}}% of original grouped cases correctly classified.
discrim.cvNote: Cross validation is done only for those cases in the analysis. In cross validation, each case is classified by the functions derived from all cases other than that case.
discrim.pctCorrectCv: {{pct}}% of cross-validated grouped cases correctly classified.
discrim.stepNote: At each step, the variable that minimizes the overall Wilks' Lambda is entered.
discrim.minFEnter: Minimum partial F to enter is {{v}}.
discrim.maxFRemove: Maximum partial F to remove is {{v}}.
discrim.maxSigEnter: Maximum significance of F to enter is {{v}}.
discrim.minSigRemove: Minimum significance of F to remove is {{v}}.
discrim.labelScore: Discriminant Scores from Function {{k}} for Analysis {{n}}
discrim.labelProb: Probabilities of Membership in Group {{g}} for Analysis {{n}}
discrim.noSelect: /SELECT is not supported; use FILTER or SELECT IF instead.
discrim.badRange: GROUPS needs a range in parentheses: variable(min,max) with min < max.
discrim.groupInVars: The grouping variable {{name}} cannot also be a discriminating variable.
discrim.notInVariables: {{name}} is in ANALYSIS but not in VARIABLES.
discrim.levelsIgnored: Inclusion levels in ANALYSIS are ignored; all listed variables are candidates.
discrim.methodUnsupported: METHOD={{method}} is not available; use DIRECT or WILKS.
discrim.finAndPin: Use either FIN/FOUT or PIN/POUT, not both.
discrim.badPin: PIN must be smaller than POUT (both between 0 and 1).
discrim.badFin: FOUT must be smaller than FIN.
discrim.ignored: {{sub}} is not supported and was ignored.
discrim.separateIgnored: CLASSIFY=SEPARATE is not available; the pooled within-groups covariance matrix is used.
discrim.noMap: The territorial map (PLOT=MAP) is not available.
discrim.tooFewGroups: At least two non-empty groups are needed.
discrim.tooFewCases: There are not more cases than groups; the analysis cannot be performed.

discriminant.title: Discriminant Analysis
discriminant.mapInfo: The territorial map is not available.
discriminant.errFin: The removal value must be smaller than the entry value.
